description.subtitle: Olympique Marseille 2025 2026 Puma Home Shorts - White
description.intro: With the Puma Olympique de Marseille 2025/2026 shorts you will bring the spirit of the Vélodrome to every play. Its comfortable fit and technical fabric offer total freedom of movement. Ideal for training or cheering in authentic style. Combine with the official t-shirt for a complete look.
key_benefits: Elite inspiration: Official design of the Marseille playing shorts.
Máxima comodidad: Tejido ligero que se adapta al movimiento.
Active breathability: dryCELL technology that keeps the skin dry.
Ajuste perfecto: Cintura elástica con cordón regulable.
Total versatility: Ideal for training, matches or everyday use.
